purpose: Establish faithful observation/execution migration and a credible matched comparison; no presumed performance advantage.

requirements: Write only in this independent integration directory.
Do not import old project modules in a way that writes old bytecode or logs.
Compare original SHA256/byte counts against the bootstrap inventory before delivery.
The old 2240 formal trials remain a separate model/experiment; never merge with Shadow results.
Preserve failed development probes in separate uniquely named evidence directories.

gates.free_object: A genuine six-DOF object, no weld/equality or scripted position attachment used to hold it.
gates.finite_actuation: All joint/tendon/lift actuators finite and original physical force signals never clipped.

physical_foundation.interpretation: All declared shape/contact/timestep combinations must pass for the claimed scope. A smaller passed scope must be explicitly named and cannot be called full three-shape acceptance. Development may change the shared model but all relevant probes must then be rerun with source hashes.

common_contact_model.scope: Only distal collision meshes are replaced by fitted smooth capsules following the original distal bodies. Visual meshes, articulated hand/wrist joints, original drives and explicit body inertia are retained.
common_contact_model.friction_scope: Point friction constrains normal and two tangential force directions. No patch torsional or rolling resistance is claimed; total contact moments from lever arms remain present.

rounded_box_model.scaling: All outside half extents and rounding radius multiply the public size factor.
rounded_box_model.inertial_definition: Single object body explicit mass=config.mass and I_body=mass/3*[b*b+c*c,a*a+c*c,a*a+b*b] for public outside half extents [a,b,c]. Composite geom density=0 prevents replicated mass.
rounded_box_model.target_contact_identity: All geom IDs whose geom_bodyid equals the one object body are included in physical support, contact pressure, environment friction and all-hand release evaluation.
rounded_box_model.control_observation: The policy still receives all-external tactile observations without target identity; target grouping is evaluation/environment bookkeeping only.
rounded_box_model.visualization: Render the actual same rounded compound geometry in the orange object material.
rounded_box_model.sharp_box_history: Earlier sharp-corner box is retained as a failed numerical/geometry design, not silently relabeled as a passed rounded object.

requirements: Report signed full 5x5 action-to-force local response, not only its diagonal.
Check positive and negative perturbations, load/contact modes, saturation, loss/reacquisition and release.
Use separate calibration and validation perturbation sequences.
Return requested and actually applied closure/driver actions and physical domain clips.
Encoder closure units must match the controller units; raw radians are kept separately.
Do not reuse the five-pad 14.25 N/closure gain or 5 ms response as a Shadow calibration.
If using the existing positive-diagonal observer/predictor/infeasibility certificate, validate its domain explicitly.
A signed/coupled model requires consistent observer, prediction, action conversion, constraints and certificate changes for all methods; solver nonconvergence is not physical infeasibility.
local_execution_model.interpretation: Prediction thresholds are engineering model-fit gates, not a real-force safety guarantee. If a simpler declared local model is not accurate enough, revise the common model rather than hiding force errors or weakening tests after performance comparison.
local_execution_model.domain_selection_rule: Largest of the tested 0.02/0.04 normalized-closure radii passing the unchanged 0.35 N RMSE and 0.75 N absolute p95 criteria, both pooled and per digit, using independently recomputed 20/40/60 ms prediction errors. Same domain for both methods.
local_execution_model.domain_interpretation: Finite prespecified multi-finger physical perturbation patterns establish an engineering sample-validated region, not a mathematical worst-case bound for every point in the cube. Error proxies retain their own selected-radius provenance.

aggregation.interpretation: Patch torques and position moments must be included. If a five-channel representation cannot preserve the required wrench, use a declared richer contact representation; do not mask the discrepancy.

auxiliary_tactile.scope: All palm and non-digit hand contacts with external bodies, excluding hand self-contact; no target-identity filtering.
auxiliary_tactile.moment_origin: palm origin, including contact torques and r cross force
auxiliary_tactile.time_alignment: same acquisition time and delay as finger tactile geometry
auxiliary_tactile.usage: Full-hand total tactile load accounting and diagnostics only. Palm may passively carry object load; it is not a separately controlled force variable.
auxiliary_tactile.reason: A non-target external collision can contribute to this sensor; without target identity it cannot be assumed to be useful object support.
auxiliary_tactile.total_load_fusion: Bring finger tactile plus auxiliary and motor-effort estimates to a consistent total-load definition. Never subtract auxiliary twice from a mixed finger-only/motor-total fusion.
auxiliary_tactile.missing_or_stale_auxiliary: Invalid auxiliary is not zero true load and cannot provide a favorable force-reduction credit.

distributed_contact.coordinate_frame: palm; same acquisition time as all tactile measurements
distributed_contact.normal_wrench_map_definition: For digit i with measured total pressure N_i, column i is sum_j (n_j/N_i)*[d_j, p_j cross d_j]. The force vector is not unit-normalized. Moment rows are physical metres, not divided by 0.05.
distributed_contact.non_normal_wrench_definition: Sum of measured tangential forces, their position moments and patch torques; not a prediction of friction capacity.
distributed_contact.raw_representation_reconstruction: normal_wrench_map @ normal_pressure + measured_non_normal_wrench equals the original sum of every finger patch wrench.
distributed_contact.contact_presence: Actual measured valid patch/pressure and distributed validity; never infer no contact merely from an averaged normal vector cancelling.
distributed_contact.shear_magnitude: Per-digit sum of patch tangential-force magnitudes; consumed by friction-ratio feedback and local shear demand.
distributed_contact.slip_magnitude: Per-digit maximum patch tangential relative speed; consumed by slip detection.
distributed_contact.net_support_capacity_coefficient: signed normal_support_coeff + mu_safe * tangent_support_coeff; negative normal contributions are retained in the QP net support inequality.
distributed_contact.positive_contact_ranking: A separate positive ranking view may be used, but it must not replace signed net-support coefficients.
distributed_contact.strict_rejection: Invalid production distributed representation yields invalid observation; no strict=False bypass or 10% point-error relaxation.
distributed_contact.legacy_point_failure_interpretation: The original single-point approximation remains failed where its error exceeds 10%. Production acceptance uses a richer measured representation instead of pretending the failed approximation passed.

physical_force_direction_check.scope: Undisturbed static holding probe with the object lifted and no imposed external object force.
physical_force_direction_check.purpose: An independent physical sign/scale anchor in addition to exact patch-coordinate reconstruction; it is not a material safety guarantee.

public_nominal_force_profile.source: Shared physical holding-force preparation profile, per shape calibration metadata.
public_nominal_force_profile.scope: Anatomical/common actuation normalization, not method-specific force tuning. Current policy scalar/PI/objective gains remain separately recorded.

algorithm_migration.current_method_semantics: Ratio is a literature-concept migration, not exact paper reproduction; unified is the current tested multi-task force-trajectory scheme. Model/adapter changes must be declared. The proposed next-generation stability-corridor policy is outside this migration.
algorithm_migration.scope: Current ratio/unified force policies take over a commonly prepared held grasp inside a validated local execution-model domain. This first transfer does not claim policy-controlled grasp discovery, contact acquisition or initial lifting.

handoff.preparation: Same publicly specified preparation and sensor/observer history for every method.
handoff.causal_control_conditions: Only public task clock, encoders and declared virtual tactile observations decide control admission. Object truth does not decide control.
handoff.evaluation_admission: Independent physical truth checks whether a valid held/lifted grasp was actually prepared; it does not feed back to control.
handoff.failed_preparation: Retain in every scheduled whole-task denominator; never silently select only prepared trials.
handoff.state_reset: Each run has fresh policy integral/ratio state, observer history, sensor queue, RNG and clock. No state from another method/run is reused.
handoff.after_handoff: Only the selected current strategy plus common execution/constraints; preparation or legacy reflexes must not continue adding actions.
handoff.local_execution_domain: Bound all executed commands to an independently validated holding trust region. Log requested/applied actions, clipping and domain exits. No extrapolation from holding calibration to CLOSING is claimed.

runtime_and_ui.equivalence_scope: Same platform/model, seed, fixed command schedule and full reset. Tolerances are for render-on/off or frontend speed changes, not different physics timestep comparisons.

initial_transfer_timing.post_handoff_first_stability_definition: Restricted waiting from fixed t=7.5 to the first independently verified stable dwell by t=8.9. If none completes, contribution is the full 1.4 s horizon. Preparation failures stay in every scheduled whole-task denominator and must be explicit in conditional summaries.

interpretation_boundaries: A source/interface/QP check is not physical acceptance.
A rendered model or moving hand is not successful strategy integration.
Finite actuator force is not a guarantee that contact force never exceeds a limit.
A passed basic physical probe does not establish success under all disturbances.
A working Shadow simulation is not validation of a clinical prosthesis.
Full-hand natural palm support is allowed and measured; this is not a claim that five finger friction alone carries the object.
This is the Shadow articulated kinematic/inertial asset with an explicitly simplified common collision/contact model; it is not validation of original mesh/6D contact mechanics.
The admitted box family, if the next matrix passes, is explicitly rounded with the declared envelope. Earlier sharp-box numerical failure remains outside the passed claim.

design_revision.reason: Original shared contact family exceeded the already fixed 2 mm hand-object penetration gate during physical development; choose a new common contact design and rerun every shape/contact/timestep lifecycle before policies.

unchanged_gates.free_object: A genuine six-DOF object, no weld/equality or scripted position attachment used to hold it.
unchanged_gates.finite_actuation: All joint/tendon/lift actuators finite and original physical force signals never clipped.

design_revision.scope: The former design remains failed history. This changes shared simulated contact mechanics, not the acceptance limit or a policy parameter. It does not establish physical realism of a specific prosthesis.

observation_revision.reason: The articulated hand has passive palm/non-digit contacts absent from a five-pad-only interface. Explicit virtual tactile instrumentation permits common full-hand observation without leaking target identity.
observation_revision.root_decision: Auxiliary wrench is common observation and total-load accounting; the current unified controller retains conservative total-load support demand. This is physical migration, not the proposed stability-corridor policy.

handoff_revision.reason: The empirically identified signed/coupled local response is a holding model. First transfer is bounded to that validated regime rather than pretending it models initial free-space closure and contact acquisition.
handoff_revision.future_scope: Full acquisition/lifting policy control needs its own contact-mode model and independent validation; it is not silently claimed by this transfer.

contact_representation.old: one equivalent point and unit normal per finger
contact_representation.new: distributed 6x5 normal wrench map with separately measured non-normal wrench and patch-magnitude features

distributed_numerical_revision.physical_timestep_reason: The complete old 1 ms/0.5 ms matrix passed holding/penetration/release but failed the fixed 15% raw lifecycle peak-force step-sensitivity gate. Refine both compared physical steps and rerun the full matrix.
distributed_numerical_revision.distributed_reason: Box/sphere multiple-patch contact cannot reliably be compressed to one unit normal and point within the original 10% wrench criterion. Retain those failed approximation diagnostics and expose a physically richer common measurement interface.

unchanged_physical_gates.free_object: A genuine six-DOF object, no weld/equality or scripted position attachment used to hold it.
unchanged_physical_gates.finite_actuation: All joint/tendon/lift actuators finite and original physical force signals never clipped.

distributed_numerical_revision.scope: Numerical/common representation migration only. No change to ratio PI law or unified task objective, no target oracle, no stability-corridor policy.

contact_clock_revision.reason: Original distal-mesh/6D contact produced release-stage impact peaks insufficiently converged under timestep halving. A common smooth distal point-friction approximation is a declared physical model revision, with every shape/contact/timestep lifecycle rerun.
contact_clock_revision.release_semantics: Immediate policy unloading/opening with a shared mechanical clearance path. It is not changed to controlled placing before opening. All subsequent real impacts remain in raw peak/exposure statistics.
contact_clock_revision.failed_development_retained: Original mesh/6D-contact and controlled-place exploratory records remain historical failures or rejected task alternatives, not replacement successful-release evidence.

rounded_box_revision.reason: Sharp box release-stage contacts at the thumb and middle-finger distal geometry caused unacceptable raw force-peak timestep sensitivity. A declared rounded compound object is a common physical-design replacement requiring complete matrix rerun.

trust_domain_revision.calibration_chain: The exported calibration may bind this active protocol while retaining foundation_protocol_sha256=v7. This protocol binds immutable response raw/summary files, not the aggregate calibration envelope, avoiding a circular hash.
